== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Stone Anchor refers to two distinct concepts within the narrative. Primarily, it is a [[Full-body Enforcer technique|full-body Enforcer technique]] utilized by combatants like Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel to manipulate their physical stability. By channeling [[madra]], the user can reinforce their skeletal structure and bind themselves to the ground, providing the necessary footing to withstand heavy impacts or to deliver powerful strikes with weapons like a hammer. The [[technique]] can also be released to facilitate movement, such as being launched by an impact. Additionally, the term describes a functional object used in spatial manipulation. As a teleportation anchor, it consists of a [[scripted stone spike]] that serves as a fixed target for gatekeys to mark and guide travelers to a specific location.}}
